- **Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API 脚本**：
```python
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 43.4mm | ID: 14.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 43.4")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 35.6")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.6",
        f"43.4",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"40.6",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 8.90
    for i in range(1, 4):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"40.4",
            f"3.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```lisp
;;; =========================================================================
;;; AutoCAD 2026 AutoLISP Parametric Engineering Drawing (c:DRAWWHEELMOLD)
;;; Intent: Layer-Disciplined 2D Section with Tolerancing & Hatching
;;; =========================================================================

(defun c:DRAWWHEELMOLD (/ old_echo old_osm lay_cen lay_prof lay_dim lay_hat)
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_osm (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 1. Setup Engineering Layers with Distinct Colors
  (setq lay_cen "01_CENTERLINE")
  (setq lay_prof "02_PROFILE")
  (setq lay_dim "03_DIMENSION")
  (setq lay_hat "04_HATCH")

  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_cen "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_cen)
  (command "LINE" (list -10.0 0.0 0.0) (list 45.6 0.0 0.0) "")

  ;; 3. Draw Outer Section Contour on Profile Layer
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_prof)
  (command "PLINE"
           (list 0.0 7.0 0.0)
           (list 0.0 21.7 0.0)
           (list 35.6 21.7 0.0)
           (list 35.6 7.0 0.0)
           "C")

  ;; 4. ANSI31 Cross-Section Hatching
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_hat)
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" 1.0 0.0 "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 5. Add Key ISO Dimensions & Tolerances
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_dim)
  ;; Overall Length Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 21.7 0.0) (list 35.6 21.7 0.0) (list 17.8 33.7 0.0))
  ;; Outer Diameter Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 35.6 0.0 0.0) (list 35.6 21.7 0.0) (list 50.6 10.85 0.0))
  ;; Inner Bore Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 0.0 0.0) (list 0.0 7.0 0.0) (list -15.0 3.5 0.0))

  ;; Restore Environment Variables
  (command "ZOOM" "E")
  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_osm)
  (princ "\n[AutoCAD 2026] Parametric Engineering Drawing Generated Successfully!")
  (princ)
)
```

```python
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()

        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions

        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "62.7"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "62.7",
        "26.9",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 精密阶梯法兰盘 参数化模型创建成功！")
```

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。
   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。

2. **X 轴对刀（设定工件回转中心为 X0.000）**：
   - 摇动手轮使刀具轻微外圆试切一段长度（约 5~10mm），切削完成后 **保持 X 轴绝对不动**。

```python
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()

        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_hydraulic_fitting.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "67.7"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]

    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(

        "67.7",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

        origin,
        "67.7",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 高压液压锥密封管接头 参数化模型创建成功！")
```

#### 1. 三维空间坐标扁平化（Flatten）数学原理
将所有几何图元坐标投影至二维平面：
$$\mathbf{P}(x, y, z) \longrightarrow \mathbf{P}'(x, y, 0)$$
在 DXF 数据组码中，将所有表示几何坐标的 10/11/12/13 组码中的 Z 坐标强制置为 0.0。

```lisp
;;; ==========================================================================
;;; 脚本名称: VIRTU_DRAWING_STANDARDIZE_AND_FLATTEN.LSP
;;; 功能: Z轴一键归零 + 国标图层标准化映射 + 字体修复 + 深度清理 (Purge)
;;; ==========================================================================

(vl-load-com)

(defun c:CleanAndStandardize ( / acad-app doc ss i ent ed code pt new-pt )
  (setq acad-app (vlax-get-acad-object))
  (setq doc (vla-get-ActiveDocument acad-app))
  (vla-StartUndoMark doc)
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  
  ;; 1. 全图 Z 轴零位扁平化 (Flatten)
  (setq ss (ssget "X"))
  (if ss
    (repeat (setq i (sslength ss))
      (setq ent (ssname ss (setq i (1- i))))
      (setq ed (entget ent))
      (foreach code '(10 11 12 13)
        (setq pt (assoc code ed))
        (if (and pt (cddr pt) (/= (cadddr pt) 0.0))
          (progn
            (setq new-pt (cons code (list (cadr pt) (caddr pt) 0.0)))
            (setq ed (subst new-pt pt ed))
          )
        )
      )
      (entmod ed)
    )
  )

  ;; 2. 批量创建国标核心图层 (GB/T 14665)
  (CreateGBLayer "01_粗实线" 7  "Continuous" 0.50)
  (CreateGBLayer "02_细实线" 2  "Continuous" 0.25)
  (CreateGBLayer "03_中心线" 1  "CENTER"     0.25)
  (CreateGBLayer "04_虚线"   4  "DASHED"     0.25)
  (CreateGBLayer "05_尺寸标注" 3 "Continuous" 0.25)
  (CreateGBLayer "06_文字标题" 6 "Continuous" 0.35)

  ;; 3. 统一全局文字样式为国标标准字体: 西文 txt.shx + 中文 gbcbig.shx
  (command "-style" "Standard" "txt.shx,gbcbig.shx" "0" "0.8" "0" "N" "N" "N")

  ;; 4. 执行三次深度无用图元清理
  (repeat 3
    (vla-PurgeAll doc)
  )
  
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 1)
  (vla-EndUndoMark doc)
  (princ "\n[Virtu] 图纸治理完成: Z轴已归零 | 国标图层已映射 | 垃圾已清理!\n")(princ)
)

(defun CreateGBLayer ( lay-name color linetype weight / layers lay-obj )
  (setq layers (vla-get-Layers (vla-get-ActiveDocument (vlax-get-acad-object))))
  (setq lay-obj (vla-Add layers lay-name))
  (vla-put-Color lay-obj color)
  (vl-catch-all-apply 'vla-put-Linetype (list lay-obj linetype))
  (vla-put-LineWeight lay-obj (fix (* weight 100)))
)
```

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 44.6")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 33.4")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"33.4",
        f"44.6",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"38.4",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 8.35
    for i in range(1, 4):

        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(

            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"41.6",
            f"3.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")
```

```lisp
(defun c:DRAW_FLANGE ( / pt0 d_out d_in w r_out r_in old_echo old_os )
  ;; 1. 保存并设置系统变量，防止屏幕闪烁与捕捉干扰

  (command "-LAYER" "M" "3-剖面线"   "C" "8" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 4. 绘制回转轴中心线
  (setvar "CLAYER" "0-中心线")
  (command "LINE" 
    (list (- (car pt0) 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    (list (+ (car pt0) w 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0)

  )

  ;; 5. 绘制上半剖面轮廓
```

```lisp
(defun c:DRAW_HYDRAULIC_FITTING ( / pt0 d_out d_in w r_out r_in old_echo old_os )
  ;; 1. 保存并设置系统变量，防止屏幕闪烁与捕捉干扰
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_os (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 2. 定义几何驱动参数
  (setq d_out 75.0
        d_in  25.0
        w     60.4
        r_out (/ d_out 2.0)
        r_in  (/ d_in 2.0)
        pt0   '(100.0 100.0 0.0) ; 基准绘制起点
  )

  ;; 3. 自动建立国标工程图层 (图层名、颜色、线型、线宽)
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "0-中心线"   "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "1-可见轮廓" "C" "7" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "2-尺寸标注" "C" "3" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "3-剖面线"   "C" "8" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 4. 绘制回转轴中心线
  (setvar "CLAYER" "0-中心线")
  (command "LINE" 
    (list (- (car pt0) 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    (list (+ (car pt0) w 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    ""
  )

  ;; 5. 绘制上半剖面轮廓
  (setvar "CLAYER" "1-可见轮廓")
  (command "PLINE"
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_in) 0.0)
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_in) 0.0)
    "C" ; 闭合多段线
  )

  ;; 6. 填充 ANSI31 剖面线
  (setvar "CLAYER" "3-剖面线")
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" "1.0" "0.0" "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 7. 自动生成核心几何尺寸标注 (宽度、外径、内孔)

  ;; 宽度标注
  (command "DIMLINEAR"

    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) (/ w 2.0)) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out 15.0) 0.0)
  )
  ;; 外径标注

  )

  ;; 8. 视口全屏缩放并恢复环境

  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_os)

)
```

#### 1. 五轴机床拓扑运动学链结构（Kinematic Component Tree）
以典型的摇篮式五轴加工中心（如 Hermle C40 / 德玛吉 DMU）为例，其运动学链为双旋转工作台构型（Table-Table A/C 轴）：
$$\text{Machine Base} \longrightarrow \begin{cases} \text{Bed} \rightarrow \text{Saddle Y} \rightarrow \text{Column X} \rightarrow \text{Head Z} \rightarrow \text{Spindle} & (\text{刀具链}) \\ \text{Table Base} \rightarrow \text{Trunnion A} \rightarrow \text{Rotary Table C} & (\text{工件链}) \end{cases}$$
刀尖相对工件表面的空间齐次坐标变换矩阵为：
$$^{W}\mathbf{T}_{T} = \left( ^{B}\mathbf{T}_{A} \cdot ^{A}\mathbf{T}_{C} \cdot ^{C}\mathbf{T}_{W} \right)^{-1} \cdot \left( ^{B}\mathbf{T}_{Y} \cdot ^{Y}\mathbf{T}_{X} \cdot ^{X}\mathbf{T}_{Z} \cdot ^{Z}\mathbf{T}_{S} \cdot ^{S}\mathbf{T}_{T} \right)$$

### 1. 工件毛坯装夹与夹持设定
1. 进入斯沃数控主界面，点击菜单栏【零件】->【定义毛坯】。
2. 毛坯形状选圆柱棒料，直径设为 `Φ144.5mm`，长度设为 `80mm`，材质选用 45# 或 Cr12MoV。

### 2. 试切对刀与 G54 工件坐标系建立序列
在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)
按下【OFFSET SETTING】->【偏置】->【几何补偿】页面：
| 刀号 | 刀具类型 | 几何补偿 (X/Z) | 磨损补偿 | **刀尖圆角 (R)** | **刀尖方位代号 (T)** | 设定依据与防过切机理 |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |

### 4. 避免过切与撞刀的关键准则
1. **刀尖圆弧半径补偿使能规范:** 执行 `G41`（左补偿）或 `G42`（右补偿）前，机床必须在空行程（G00/G01）且切入工件之前完成矢量建立；切削完毕脱离工件后，必须立即使用 `G40` 取消补偿。

   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。
   - 刀具退回 X 正方向，进入 CNC 系统面板：【OFFSET SETTING】 $\to$ 【坐标系 (WORK)】 $\to$ 光标移动至 `G54` 的 `Z` 坐标列。

```python
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Cr12MoV | OD: 147.0mm | ID: 14.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 147.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 84.7")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 12.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"84.7",
        f"147.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"89.7",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 21.18
    for i in range(1, 4):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"123.0",
            f"24.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import NXOpen
```

```python
def create_parametric_stepped_shaft():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 多级传动阶梯轴"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()

        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "57.9"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")

    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "57.9",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )
```

```python
import NXOpen
```

```python
def create_parametric_flange():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 精密阶梯法兰盘"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_flange.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "129.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "30.9"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "67.6"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "67.6",
        "129.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "67.6",
        "30.9",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 精密阶梯法兰盘 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=129.0, D_BORE=30.9, TOTAL_LENGTH=67.6 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 44.1mm | ID: 14.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 44.1")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 35.2")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.2",
        f"44.1",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"40.2",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 8.80
    for i in range(1, 4):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"41.1",
            f"3.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```lisp
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
```

在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。

- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### VERICUT 9.6：Force / OptiPath 物理切削力与切屑厚度自适应优化算法 #### 1. 物理切削力学与切屑厚度自适应模型 传统 CAM 编程基于线性进给速度 $F = n \cdot z \cdot f_z$。但在实际侧铣加工中，当切宽 $a_e$ 较小时，瞬时切屑厚度小于每齿进给量（切屑变薄效应 Chip Thinning）。 最大未变形切屑厚度 $h_{max}$ 为： $$h_{max} = f_z \cdot \sqrt{\frac{a_e}{D}} \quad (a_e \le \frac{D}{2})$$ 根据金属切削基本力学 Kienzle 方程，主切削力 $F_c$ 为： $$F_c = k_{c1.1} \cdot b \cdot h^{1 - m_c} = k_{c1.1} \cdot a_p \cdot \left( f_z \sin\phi \right)^{1 - m_c}$$ 式中 $k_{c1.1}$ 为单位切削力，$m_c$ 为材料切削系数，$a_p$ 为轴向切深。 - **拐角减速（Corner Deceleration）**：内圆弧拐角处刀具接触包角 $\theta$ 从 $30^\circ$ 瞬间增大至 $120^\circ$，切削力呈指数级上升。VERICUT Force 自动将进给率 $F$ 降低至原来的 $40\% \sim 50\%$； - **直线轻载加速（Air Cut Acceleration）**：在空行程或进刀切入阶段，自动将进给率提升至机床最大加工进给 $F_{max}$。 #### 2.     """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 多级传动阶梯轴"""
```python
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"

        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_stepped_shaft.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "62.1"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:

    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "62.1",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "62.1",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 多级传动阶梯轴 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=60.0, D_BORE=18.0, TOTAL_LENGTH=62.1 已完成几何双向挂接。")
```

```python
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 35.6")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.6",
        f"44.5",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
```

```python
import NXOpen

def create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 高压液压锥密封管接头"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_hydraulic_fitting.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "57.6"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "57.6",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "57.6",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 高压液压锥密封管接头 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=60.0, D_BORE=18.0, TOTAL_LENGTH=57.6 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting()
```

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF

def create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 高压液压锥密封管接头"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_hydraulic_fitting.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "57.9"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "57.9",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "57.9",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 高压液压锥密封管接头 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=60.0, D_BORE=18.0, TOTAL_LENGTH=57.9 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting()
```

在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。

  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

```lisp
(defun c:DRAW_WHEEL_MOLD ( / pt0 d_out d_in w r_out r_in old_echo old_os )
  ;; 1. 保存并设置系统变量，防止屏幕闪烁与捕捉干扰

        r_out (/ d_out 2.0)

  ;; 4. 绘制回转轴中心线
  (setvar "CLAYER" "0-中心线")
  (command "LINE" 
    (list (- (car pt0) 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    (list (+ (car pt0) w 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    ""
  )

  ;; 5. 绘制上半剖面轮廓
  (setvar "CLAYER" "1-可见轮廓")
  (command "PLINE"

    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_in) 0.0)
```

```python
import NXOpen

def main():

    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work
```

```python
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 33.8")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"33.8",
        f"45.1",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(

        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"38.8",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    pitch = 8.45

        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(

        )

    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")
```

```lisp
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
```

```python
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 3.0")

    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"48.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"50.0",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 11.25
    for i in range(1, 4):

        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(

        )

    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 35.0mm | ID: 14.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 35.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 45.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 4.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"35.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"50.0",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 7.50
    for i in range(1, 6):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"27.0",
            f"8.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

### 1. 工件毛坯装夹与夹持设定
1. 进入斯沃数控主界面，点击菜单栏【零件】->【定义毛坯】。
2. 毛坯形状选圆柱棒料，直径设为 `Φ81.4mm`，长度设为 `80mm`，材质选用 45# 或 Cr12MoV。

### 2. 试切对刀与 G54 工件坐标系建立序列
在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)

```python
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

        f"140.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]

        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"50.0",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
```

```vb
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
```

```vb
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SOLIDWORKS\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\零件.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)

    swEqnMgr.Add 2, """Total_L"" = 44.3", True
    swEqnMgr.Add 3, """R_Outer"" = ""D_Outer"" / 2.0", True
    swEqnMgr.Add 4, """R_Bore"" = ""D_Bore"" / 2.0", True

    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("前视基准面", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)

    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, l_m, 0, 0

    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, r_out_m, 0, l_m, r_out_m, 0

    Part.EditRebuild3
```

```python
def create_parametric_flange():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 精密阶梯法兰盘"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_flange.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "118.1"),
        ("D_BORE", "27.7"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "44.7"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "44.7",
        "118.1",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "44.7",
        "27.7",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 精密阶梯法兰盘 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=118.1, D_BORE=27.7, TOTAL_LENGTH=44.7 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_flange()
```

```lisp
(defun c:DRAW_BUSHING ( / pt0 d_out d_in w r_out r_in old_echo old_os )
  ;; 1. 保存并设置系统变量，防止屏幕闪烁与捕捉干扰
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_os (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 2. 定义几何驱动参数
  (setq d_out 48.9
        d_in  30.6
        w     55.9
        r_out (/ d_out 2.0)
        r_in  (/ d_in 2.0)
        pt0   '(100.0 100.0 0.0) ; 基准绘制起点
  )

  ;; 3. 自动建立国标工程图层 (图层名、颜色、线型、线宽)
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "0-中心线"   "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "1-可见轮廓" "C" "7" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "2-尺寸标注" "C" "3" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "3-剖面线"   "C" "8" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 4. 绘制回转轴中心线
  (setvar "CLAYER" "0-中心线")
  (command "LINE" 
    (list (- (car pt0) 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    (list (+ (car pt0) w 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    ""
  )

  ;; 5. 绘制上半剖面轮廓
  (setvar "CLAYER" "1-可见轮廓")
  (command "PLINE"
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_in) 0.0)
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_in) 0.0)
    "C" ; 闭合多段线
  )

  ;; 6. 填充 ANSI31 剖面线
  (setvar "CLAYER" "3-剖面线")
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" "1.0" "0.0" "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 7. 自动生成核心几何尺寸标注 (宽度、外径、内孔)
  (setvar "CLAYER" "2-尺寸标注")
  ;; 宽度标注
  (command "DIMLINEAR" 
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) (/ w 2.0)) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out 15.0) 0.0)
  )
  ;; 外径标注
  (command "DIMLINEAR"
    (list (car pt0) (cadr pt0) 0.0)
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (- (car pt0) 20.0) (+ (cadr pt0) (/ r_out 2.0)) 0.0)
  )

  ;; 8. 视口全屏缩放并恢复环境

  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_os)
  (princ (strcat "\n>>> [AutoCAD 2026] " "双向储油耐磨导套" " 参数化工程图已绘制完成！图层、中心线及尺寸标注均已就绪。\n"))
  (princ)
)
```

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF

def create_parametric_stepped_shaft():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 多级传动阶梯轴"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_stepped_shaft.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "64.0"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "64.0",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "64.0",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 多级传动阶梯轴 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=60.0, D_BORE=18.0, TOTAL_LENGTH=64.0 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_stepped_shaft()
```

```python
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()

    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 35.2")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.2",
        f"46.1",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(

        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"40.2",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 8.80
```

| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。
   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。
   - 刀具退回 X 正方向，进入 CNC 系统面板：【OFFSET SETTING】 $\to$ 【坐标系 (WORK)】 $\to$ 光标移动至 `G54` 的 `Z` 坐标列。

## 1. 虚拟车床配置与工件装夹

## 2. 刀塔刀具装配与刀沿方位号配置
| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| **T0202** | 圆弧成型槽刀 | R2.0全圆弧硬质合金刀片 | $2.0\text{mm}$ | **8号** (径向直插成型方位) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。
   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。
   - 刀具退回 X 正方向，进入 CNC 系统面板：【OFFSET SETTING】 $\to$ 【坐标系 (WORK)】 $\to$ 光标移动至 `G54` 的 `Z` 坐标列。

2. **X 轴对刀（设定工件回转中心为 X0.000）**：
   - 摇动手轮使刀具轻微外圆试切一段长度（约 5~10mm），切削完成后 **保持 X 轴绝对不动**。
   - 沿 Z 轴正方向退出刀具，停止主轴。

```python
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: AL7075-T6 | OD: 66.2mm | ID: 14.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 66.2")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 7075.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"7075.0",
        f"66.2",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"7080.0",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 1768.75
    for i in range(1, 4):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"64.2",
            f"2.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

### 1. 工件毛坯装夹与夹持设定
1. 进入斯沃数控主界面，点击菜单栏【零件】->【定义毛坯】。
2. 毛坯形状选圆柱棒料，直径设为 `Φ55.8mm`，长度设为 `80mm`，材质选用 45# 或 Cr12MoV。
3. 点击【卡盘夹紧】，夹持深度设为 `20.0mm`（工件有效外伸 `60.0mm`），确认无干涉。

### 2. 试切对刀与 G54 工件坐标系建立序列
在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)
按下【OFFSET SETTING】->【偏置】->【几何补偿】页面：
| 刀号 | 刀具类型 | 几何补偿 (X/Z) | 磨损补偿 | **刀尖圆角 (R)** | **刀尖方位代号 (T)** | 设定依据与防过切机理 |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **T01** | 前置外圆右偏车刀 (CNMG) | 试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.8`** | **`3`** | 前置刀架主偏角93°标准刀片，假想刀尖方位指向右上方，代号为 3。 |
| **T02** | 全圆弧切槽刀 (R3.0) | 槽刀左刃对刀 | 0.00 | **`3.0`** | **`8`** (圆心) 或 **`3`** (左尖) | 若以圆弧槽刀刀头圆心编程，必须录入 **8**；若以左顶点对刀则录入 **3**。 |
| **T03** | 内孔镗孔车刀 (CCMT) | 内孔试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.4`** | **`2`** | 内孔镗刀前置假想刀尖指向工件内侧，代号必须为 2。 |

### 4. 避免过切与撞刀的关键准则
1. **刀尖圆弧半径补偿使能规范:** 执行 `G41`（左补偿）或 `G42`（右补偿）前，机床必须在空行程（G00/G01）且切入工件之前完成矢量建立；切削完毕脱离工件后，必须立即使用 `G40` 取消补偿。
2. **防过切代号检查:** 若将槽刀或成型刀的 T 代码错误设为 0 或 9，在切削圆弧过渡槽时，数控系统将发生未补偿计算，产生高达 `R*(1 - sin45°)` 的过切深度（对于 R3 刀具过切近 0.88mm，直接导致零件报废）。按照上述规范录入后，斯沃仿真过切量恒定为 0。

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF

def create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 高压液压锥密封管接头"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_hydraulic_fitting.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "64.3"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "64.3",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "64.3",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 高压液压锥密封管接头 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=60.0, D_BORE=18.0, TOTAL_LENGTH=64.3 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting()
```

```python
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()

    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 54.1")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 3.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"54.1",
        f"171.3",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"59.1",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 4.16

        )

    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")
```

```python
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"35.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)

        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"50.0",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)

    for i in range(1, 5):

    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF

def create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 高压液压锥密封管接头"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_hydraulic_fitting.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "49.9"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "49.9",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "49.9",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 高压液压锥密封管接头 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=60.0, D_BORE=18.0, TOTAL_LENGTH=49.9 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting()
```

1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：

```lisp
(defun c:DRAW_WHEEL_MOLD ( / pt0 d_out d_in w r_out r_in old_echo old_os )
  ;; 1. 保存并设置系统变量，防止屏幕闪烁与捕捉干扰
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_os (getvar "OSMODE"))

  ;; 2. 定义几何驱动参数
  (setq d_out 54.7
        d_in  15.0
        w     77.5
        r_out (/ d_out 2.0)
        r_in  (/ d_in 2.0)
        pt0   '(100.0 100.0 0.0) ; 基准绘制起点
  )

  ;; 3. 自动建立国标工程图层 (图层名、颜色、线型、线宽)
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "0-中心线"   "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")

  (command "-LAYER" "M" "2-尺寸标注" "C" "3" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" "3-剖面线"   "C" "8" "" "LT" "Continuous" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 4. 绘制回转轴中心线
  (setvar "CLAYER" "0-中心线")
  (command "LINE" 
    (list (- (car pt0) 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    (list (+ (car pt0) w 15.0) (cadr pt0) 0.0) 
    ""
  )

  ;; 5. 绘制上半剖面轮廓
  (setvar "CLAYER" "1-可见轮廓")
  (command "PLINE"
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_in) 0.0)
    (list (car pt0) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_out) 0.0)
    (list (+ (car pt0) w) (+ (cadr pt0) r_in) 0.0)
    "C" ; 闭合多段线
```

#### 1. 极坐标数学推导与边界多段线几何方程
设起始点为 $P_1(x_1, y_1)$，终止点为 $P_2(x_2, y_2)$，路径总长度与倾角为：
$$L = \sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2}, \quad \theta = \operatorname{atan2}(y_2 - y_1, x_2 - x_1)$$
路径半宽为 $w = W / 2$。边界法向偏置角为 $\theta \pm \frac{\pi}{2}$。四个角点坐标为：
$$\begin{cases} C_1 = P_1 + w \cdot (-\sin\theta, \cos\theta) \\ C_2 = P_2 + w \cdot (-\sin\theta, \cos\theta) \\ C_3 = P_2 - w \cdot (-\sin\theta, \cos\theta) \\ C_4 = P_1 - w \cdot (-\sin\theta, \cos\theta) \end{cases}$$

```lisp
  (setq curr-dist step)
```

### 1. 工件毛坯装夹与夹持设定
1. 进入斯沃数控主界面，点击菜单栏【零件】->【定义毛坯】。
2. 毛坯形状选圆柱棒料，直径设为 `Φ63.0mm`，长度设为 `80mm`，材质选用 45# 或 Cr12MoV。
3. 点击【卡盘夹紧】，夹持深度设为 `20.0mm`（工件有效外伸 `60.0mm`），确认无干涉。

在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)
按下【OFFSET SETTING】->【偏置】->【几何补偿】页面：
| 刀号 | 刀具类型 | 几何补偿 (X/Z) | 磨损补偿 | **刀尖圆角 (R)** | **刀尖方位代号 (T)** | 设定依据与防过切机理 |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **T01** | 前置外圆右偏车刀 (CNMG) | 试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.8`** | **`3`** | 前置刀架主偏角93°标准刀片，假想刀尖方位指向右上方，代号为 3。 |

1. **刀尖圆弧半径补偿使能规范:** 执行 `G41`（左补偿）或 `G42`（右补偿）前，机床必须在空行程（G00/G01）且切入工件之前完成矢量建立；切削完毕脱离工件后，必须立即使用 `G40` 取消补偿。

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF

def create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 高压液压锥密封管接头"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_hydraulic_fitting.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "60.0"),
        ("D_BORE", "18.0"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "62.3"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "62.3",
        "60.0",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "62.3",
        "18.0",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 高压液压锥密封管接头 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=60.0, D_BORE=18.0, TOTAL_LENGTH=62.3 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_hydraulic_fitting()
```

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF

def create_parametric_flange():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 精密阶梯法兰盘"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_flange.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "110.8"),
        ("D_BORE", "26.6"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "50.0"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "50.0",
        "110.8",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "50.0",
        "26.6",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 精密阶梯法兰盘 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=110.8, D_BORE=26.6, TOTAL_LENGTH=50.0 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_flange()
```

```lisp
  ;; 1. 保存并设置系统变量，防止屏幕闪烁与捕捉干扰

  (setq old_os (getvar "OSMODE"))
```

```python
import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF

def create_parametric_bearing_cap():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 深沟球轴承密封端盖"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:
        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()
        file_new.TemplateFileName = "model-plain-1-mm-template.prt"
        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_bearing_cap.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "75.2"),
        ("D_BORE", "46.4"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "43.4"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "43.4",
        "75.2",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "43.4",
        "46.4",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 深沟球轴承密封端盖 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=75.2, D_BORE=46.4, TOTAL_LENGTH=43.4 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_parametric_bearing_cap()
```

3. 点击【卡盘夹紧】，夹持深度设为 `20.0mm`（工件有效外伸 `60.0mm`），确认无干涉。

### 2. 试切对刀与 G54 工件坐标系建立序列
在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)
按下【OFFSET SETTING】->【偏置】->【几何补偿】页面：
| 刀号 | 刀具类型 | 几何补偿 (X/Z) | 磨损补偿 | **刀尖圆角 (R)** | **刀尖方位代号 (T)** | 设定依据与防过切机理 |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **T01** | 前置外圆右偏车刀 (CNMG) | 试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.8`** | **`3`** | 前置刀架主偏角93°标准刀片，假想刀尖方位指向右上方，代号为 3。 |
| **T02** | 全圆弧切槽刀 (R3.0) | 槽刀左刃对刀 | 0.00 | **`3.0`** | **`8`** (圆心) 或 **`3`** (左尖) | 若以圆弧槽刀刀头圆心编程，必须录入 **8**；若以左顶点对刀则录入 **3**。 |
| **T03** | 内孔镗孔车刀 (CCMT) | 内孔试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.4`** | **`2`** | 内孔镗刀前置假想刀尖指向工件内侧，代号必须为 2。 |

### 4. 避免过切与撞刀的关键准则
1. **刀尖圆弧半径补偿使能规范:** 执行 `G41`（左补偿）或 `G42`（右补偿）前，机床必须在空行程（G00/G01）且切入工件之前完成矢量建立；切削完毕脱离工件后，必须立即使用 `G40` 取消补偿。
2. **防过切代号检查:** 若将槽刀或成型刀的 T 代码错误设为 0 或 9，在切削圆弧过渡槽时，数控系统将发生未补偿计算，产生高达 `R*(1 - sin45°)` 的过切深度（对于 R3 刀具过切近 0.88mm，直接导致零件报废）。按照上述规范录入后，斯沃仿真过切量恒定为 0。

```python
def main():

    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()

    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 86.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 12.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"86.0",
        f"133.9",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)

        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"91.0",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

            f"24.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")
```

## 1. 虚拟车床配置与工件装夹

  - 卡盘装夹：选择【三爪自定心液压卡盘】，夹持长度 $20.0\text{mm}$，工件伸出端长度 $91.0\text{mm}$。

## 2. 刀塔刀具装配与刀沿方位号配置
| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T0101** | 外圆粗车刀 | WNMG080408 (80°菱形) | $0.8\text{mm}$ | **3号** (右偏外圆车刀标准方位) |
| **T0202** | 圆弧成型槽刀 | R12.0全圆弧硬质合金刀片 | $12.0\text{mm}$ | **8号** (径向直插成型方位) |
| **T0303** | 内孔镗刀 | CCMT09T304 (80°微型内孔镗刀) | $0.4\text{mm}$ | **2号** (标准内孔镗刀方位) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。

## 2. 刀塔刀具装配与刀沿方位号配置
| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T0101** | 外圆粗车刀 | WNMG080408 (80°菱形) | $0.8\text{mm}$ | **3号** (右偏外圆车刀标准方位) |
| **T0202** | 圆弧成型槽刀 | R3.5全圆弧硬质合金刀片 | $3.5\text{mm}$ | **8号** (径向直插成型方位) |
| **T0303** | 内孔镗刀 | CCMT09T304 (80°微型内孔镗刀) | $0.4\text{mm}$ | **2号** (标准内孔镗刀方位) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。
   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。
   - 刀具退回 X 正方向，进入 CNC 系统面板：【OFFSET SETTING】 $\to$ 【坐标系 (WORK)】 $\to$ 光标移动至 `G54` 的 `Z` 坐标列。
   - 键入 `Z0.`，按下屏幕下方软键【测量 (MEASUR)】，系统自动计算并写入 Z 轴工件原点偏移量。
2. **X 轴对刀（设定工件回转中心为 X0.000）**：
   - 摇动手轮使刀具轻微外圆试切一段长度（约 5~10mm），切削完成后 **保持 X 轴绝对不动**。
   - 沿 Z 轴正方向退出刀具，停止主轴。
   - 使用游标卡尺测量试切外圆实际直径 $D_{meas}$。
   - 进入 `G54` 的 `X` 坐标列，输入 `X[实际测量值]`，按下【测量 (MEASUR)】软键完成标定。

# 斯沃数控仿真软件 (SSCNC FANUC 0i-TF) 实操对刀手册

## 1. 虚拟车床配置与工件装夹
- **机床型号**：选择【FANUC 0i-TF 卧式斜床身数控车床】。
- **毛坯设置**：
  - 材料选择：`AL7075-T6`
  - 毛坯规格：外径 $\varnothing 66.8\text{mm}$，总长 $7095.0\text{mm}$
  - 卡盘装夹：选择【三爪自定心液压卡盘】，夹持长度 $20.0\text{mm}$，工件伸出端长度 $7080.0\text{mm}$。

## 2. 刀塔刀具装配与刀沿方位号配置
| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T0101** | 外圆粗车刀 | WNMG080408 (80°菱形) | $0.8\text{mm}$ | **3号** (右偏外圆车刀标准方位) |
| **T0202** | 圆弧成型槽刀 | R1.0全圆弧硬质合金刀片 | $1.0\text{mm}$ | **8号** (径向直插成型方位) |
| **T0303** | 内孔镗刀 | CCMT09T304 (80°微型内孔镗刀) | $0.4\text{mm}$ | **2号** (标准内孔镗刀方位) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。
   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。
   - 刀具退回 X 正方向，进入 CNC 系统面板：【OFFSET SETTING】 $\to$ 【坐标系 (WORK)】 $\to$ 光标移动至 `G54` 的 `Z` 坐标列。
   - 键入 `Z0.`，按下屏幕下方软键【测量 (MEASUR)】，系统自动计算并写入 Z 轴工件原点偏移量。
2. **X 轴对刀（设定工件回转中心为 X0.000）**：
   - 摇动手轮使刀具轻微外圆试切一段长度（约 5~10mm），切削完成后 **保持 X 轴绝对不动**。
   - 沿 Z 轴正方向退出刀具，停止主轴。
   - 使用游标卡尺测量试切外圆实际直径 $D_{meas}$。
   - 进入 `G54` 的 `X` 坐标列，输入 `X[实际测量值]`，按下【测量 (MEASUR)】软键完成标定。

## 4. 仿真运行验证
- 调入宏程序 `O2026.NC`，闭合防护门，切入【自动加工 (AUTO)】模式，单段试切无过切后按下【循环启动 (CYCLE START)】。

```vb
Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    ' 新建标准零件模板
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SOLIDWORKS\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\零件.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)

    swEqnMgr.Add 2, """Total_L"" = 38.1", True
    swEqnMgr.Add 3, """R_Outer"" = ""D_Outer"" / 2.0", True
    swEqnMgr.Add 4, """R_Bore"" = ""D_Bore"" / 2.0", True
    
    ' 2. 选择前视基准面并启动草图绘制
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("前视基准面", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    
    ' 3. 绘制旋转中心线与截面回转轮廓 (单位换算为米制 MKS)
    Dim l_m As Double, r_out_m As Double, r_bore_m As Double
    l_m = 38.1 / 1000.0
    r_out_m = (123.9 / 2.0) / 1000.0
    r_bore_m = (28.8 / 2.0) / 1000.0
    
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, l_m, 0, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, r_bore_m, 0, 0, r_out_m, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, r_out_m, 0, l_m, r_out_m, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine l_m, r_out_m, 0, l_m, r_bore_m, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine l_m, r_bore_m, 0, 0, r_bore_m, 0
    
    ' 4. 执行 360 度单向旋转特征成型

End Sub
```

### 1. 工件毛坯装夹与夹持设定
1. 进入斯沃数控主界面，点击菜单栏【零件】->【定义毛坯】。
2. 毛坯形状选圆柱棒料，直径设为 `Φ39.1mm`，长度设为 `80mm`，材质选用 45# 或 Cr12MoV。
3. 点击【卡盘夹紧】，夹持深度设为 `20.0mm`（工件有效外伸 `60.0mm`），确认无干涉。

### 2. 试切对刀与 G54 工件坐标系建立序列
在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)
按下【OFFSET SETTING】->【偏置】->【几何补偿】页面：
| 刀号 | 刀具类型 | 几何补偿 (X/Z) | 磨损补偿 | **刀尖圆角 (R)** | **刀尖方位代号 (T)** | 设定依据与防过切机理 |

1. **刀尖圆弧半径补偿使能规范:** 执行 `G41`（左补偿）或 `G42`（右补偿）前，机床必须在空行程（G00/G01）且切入工件之前完成矢量建立；切削完毕脱离工件后，必须立即使用 `G40` 取消补偿。

1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：

   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。
   - 刀具退回 X 正方向，进入 CNC 系统面板：【OFFSET SETTING】 $\to$ 【坐标系 (WORK)】 $\to$ 光标移动至 `G54` 的 `Z` 坐标列。

2. **X 轴对刀（设定工件回转中心为 X0.000）**：
   - 摇动手轮使刀具轻微外圆试切一段长度（约 5~10mm），切削完成后 **保持 X 轴绝对不动**。
   - 沿 Z 轴正方向退出刀具，停止主轴。

```python
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 84.5")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 12.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(

        f"135.1",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
```

1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：

2. **X 轴对刀（设定工件回转中心为 X0.000）**：

```lisp
;;; Intent: Layer-Disciplined 2D Section with Tolerancing & Hatching
;;; =========================================================================

(defun c:DRAWWHEELMOLD (/ old_echo old_osm lay_cen lay_prof lay_dim lay_hat)
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_osm (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 1. Setup Engineering Layers with Distinct Colors
  (setq lay_cen "01_CENTERLINE")
  (setq lay_prof "02_PROFILE")
  (setq lay_dim "03_DIMENSION")
  (setq lay_hat "04_HATCH")

  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_cen "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_cen)
  (command "LINE" (list -10.0 0.0 0.0) (list 79.5 0.0 0.0) "")

  ;; 3. Draw Outer Section Contour on Profile Layer
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_prof)
  (command "PLINE"
           (list 0.0 7.0 0.0)
           (list 0.0 82.1 0.0)
           (list 69.5 82.1 0.0)
           (list 69.5 7.0 0.0)
           "C")

  ;; 4. ANSI31 Cross-Section Hatching
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_hat)
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" 1.0 0.0 "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 5. Add Key ISO Dimensions & Tolerances
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_dim)
  ;; Overall Length Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 82.1 0.0) (list 69.5 82.1 0.0) (list 34.75 94.1 0.0))
  ;; Outer Diameter Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 69.5 0.0 0.0) (list 69.5 82.1 0.0) (list 84.5 41.05 0.0))
  ;; Inner Bore Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 0.0 0.0) (list 0.0 7.0 0.0) (list -15.0 3.5 0.0))

  ;; Restore Environment Variables
  (command "ZOOM" "E")
  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_osm)
  (princ "\n[AutoCAD 2026] Parametric Engineering Drawing Generated Successfully!")
  (princ)
)
```

在 **斯沃数控仿真软件 (SSCNC)** 的 **FANUC 0i-TF** 车床环境中，加工 **微型机冷成型轮模** 的标准化车间级实操全流程如下：

### 1. 工件毛坯装夹与夹持设定
1. 进入斯沃数控主界面，点击菜单栏【零件】->【定义毛坯】。
2. 毛坯形状选圆柱棒料，直径设为 `Φ62.8mm`，长度设为 `80mm`，材质选用 45# 或 Cr12MoV。
3. 点击【卡盘夹紧】，夹持深度设为 `20.0mm`（工件有效外伸 `60.0mm`），确认无干涉。

### 2. 试切对刀与 G54 工件坐标系建立序列
在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)
按下【OFFSET SETTING】->【偏置】->【几何补偿】页面：
| 刀号 | 刀具类型 | 几何补偿 (X/Z) | 磨损补偿 | **刀尖圆角 (R)** | **刀尖方位代号 (T)** | 设定依据与防过切机理 |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **T01** | 前置外圆右偏车刀 (CNMG) | 试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.8`** | **`3`** | 前置刀架主偏角93°标准刀片，假想刀尖方位指向右上方，代号为 3。 |
| **T02** | 全圆弧切槽刀 (R3.0) | 槽刀左刃对刀 | 0.00 | **`3.0`** | **`8`** (圆心) 或 **`3`** (左尖) | 若以圆弧槽刀刀头圆心编程，必须录入 **8**；若以左顶点对刀则录入 **3**。 |
| **T03** | 内孔镗孔车刀 (CCMT) | 内孔试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.4`** | **`2`** | 内孔镗刀前置假想刀尖指向工件内侧，代号必须为 2。 |

### 4. 避免过切与撞刀的关键准则
1. **刀尖圆弧半径补偿使能规范:** 执行 `G41`（左补偿）或 `G42`（右补偿）前，机床必须在空行程（G00/G01）且切入工件之前完成矢量建立；切削完毕脱离工件后，必须立即使用 `G40` 取消补偿。
2. **防过切代号检查:** 若将槽刀或成型刀的 T 代码错误设为 0 或 9，在切削圆弧过渡槽时，数控系统将发生未补偿计算，产生高达 `R*(1 - sin45°)` 的过切深度（对于 R3 刀具过切近 0.88mm，直接导致零件报废）。按照上述规范录入后，斯沃仿真过切量恒定为 0。

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。
   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。

   - 摇动手轮使刀具轻微外圆试切一段长度（约 5~10mm），切削完成后 **保持 X 轴绝对不动**。

```vb
' =========================================================================
' SolidWorks Macro: 递归遍历装配体树并导出结构化 BOM 物理属性清单
' 支持过滤轻化/压缩件，自动提取图号、图名、材质及称重质量
' =========================================================================
Option Explicit

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim swModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swAssy As SldWorks.AssemblyDoc
Dim dictParts As Object
Dim dictInfo As Object

Sub main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set swModel = swApp.ActiveDoc
    
    If swModel Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先打开一个 SolidWorks 装配体文件！", vbCritical, "Virtu CAM"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If swModel.GetType <> swDocASSEMBLY Then
        MsgBox "当前活动文档不是装配体，请在 .SLDASM 环境中运行！", vbExclamation, "Virtu CAM"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Set swAssy = swModel
    Set dictParts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictInfo = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    Dim swRootComp As SldWorks.Component2
    Dim swConf As SldWorks.Configuration
    Set swConf = swAssy.GetActiveConfiguration
    Set swRootComp = swConf.GetRootComponent3(True)
    
    TraverseComponent swRootComp, 1
    
    Dim outPath As String
    outPath = Left(swModel.GetPathName, InStrRev(swModel.GetPathName, ".")) & "csv"
    If outPath = "csv" Then outPath = "C:\Temp\Virtu_Assembly_BOM.csv"
    
    Dim fso As Object, fOut As Object
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set fOut = fso.CreateTextFile(outPath, True, True)
    
    fOut.WriteLine "物料图号,零件名称,材料材质,装配数量,单件质量(kg),总质量(kg)"
    
    Dim key As Variant
    For Each key In dictParts.Keys
        Dim count As Long
        count = dictParts(key)
        Dim info As String
        info = dictInfo(key)
        
        Dim fields() As String
        fields = Split(info, "|")
        Dim mass As Double
        mass = CDbl(fields(2))
        Dim totalMass As Double
        totalMass = Round(mass * count, 3)
        
        fOut.WriteLine fields(0) & "," & fields(1) & "," & fields(3) & "," & count & "," & mass & "," & totalMass
    Next key
    
    fOut.Close
    MsgBox "装配体 BOM 属性清单已成功导出至：" & vbCrLf & outPath, vbInformation, "Virtu 工业智能体"
End Sub

Sub TraverseComponent(swComp As SldWorks.Component2, depth As Long)
    Dim vChildren As Variant
    vChildren = swComp.GetChildren
    If IsEmpty(vChildren) Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 0 To UBound(vChildren)
        Dim swChild As SldWorks.Component2
        Set swChild = vChildren(i)
        
        If swChild.GetSuppression <> swComponentSuppressed Then
            Dim childModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
            Set childModel = swChild.GetModelDoc2
            
            If Not childModel Is Nothing Then
                If childModel.GetType = swDocPART Then
                    Dim custPropMgr As SldWorks.CustomPropertyManager
                    Set custPropMgr = childModel.Extension.CustomPropertyManager("")
                    Dim valOut As String, resolvedVal As String
                    
                    custPropMgr.Get4 "图号", False, valOut, resolvedVal
                    Dim partNo As String
                    partNo = IIf(resolvedVal <> "", resolvedVal, swChild.Name2)
                    
                    custPropMgr.Get4 "名称", False, valOut, resolvedVal
                    Dim partDesc As String
                    partDesc = IIf(resolvedVal <> "", resolvedVal, childModel.GetTitle)
                    
                    Dim mat As String
                    mat = childModel.MaterialIdName
                    If mat = "" Then mat = "未指定材质"
                    
                    Dim swMassProp As SldWorks.MassProperty
                    Set swMassProp = childModel.Extension.CreateMassProperty
                    Dim unitMass As Double
                    If Not swMassProp Is Nothing Then
                        unitMass = Round(swMassProp.Mass, 3)
                    Else
                        unitMass = 0
                    End If
                    
                    If dictParts.Exists(partNo) Then
                        dictParts(partNo) = dictParts(partNo) + 1
                    Else
                        dictParts.Add partNo, 1
                        dictInfo.Add partNo, partNo & "|" & partDesc & "|" & unitMass & "|" & mat
                    End If
                ElseIf childModel.GetType = swDocASSEMBLY Then
                    TraverseComponent swChild, depth + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub
```

```python
def create_parametric_bushing():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 双向储油耐磨导套"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()

        # 新建标准毫米制模型部件
        file_new = session.Parts.FileNew()

        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_bushing.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "47.2"),
        ("D_BORE", "21.3"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "49.3"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:
        expr_str = f"{p_name}={p_val}"
        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "49.3",
        "47.2",
        direction
    )

    # 3. 执行布尔差集减去中心通孔 (Boolean Difference for bore)
    bore_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "49.3",
        "21.3",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 双向储油耐磨导套 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=47.2, D_BORE=21.3, TOTAL_LENGTH=49.3 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
import NXOpen
```

```python
def create_parametric_bushing():
    """Siemens NX 12.0 NXOpen Python 参数化建模脚本 - 双向储油耐磨导套"""
    session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = session.Parts.Work
    
    if work_part is None:

        file_new.Application = NXOpen.FileNewApplication.Modeling
        file_new.Units = NXOpen.PartUnits.Millimeters
        file_new.NewFileName = "parametric_bushing.prt"
        work_part = file_new.Commit()
        file_new.Destroy()

    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm_unit = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")

    # 1. 建立与零件特征绑定的参数化表达式列表
    params = [
        ("D_OUTER", "49.3"),
        ("D_BORE", "30.3"),
        ("TOTAL_LENGTH", "59.1"),
        ("R_OUTER", "D_OUTER/2.0"),
        ("R_BORE", "D_BORE/2.0")
    ]
    for p_name, p_val in params:

        exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits(expr_str, mm_unit)

    # 2. 调用 UF_MODL 原生 API 创建外形实体 (圆柱体 base cylinder)
    origin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    direction = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    cyl_tag = uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        origin,
        "59.1",
        "49.3",

        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        origin,
        "59.1",
        "30.3",
        direction
    )

    # 4. 建立更新标记并保存部件
    work_part.Save(NXOpen.BasePart.SaveComponents.TrueValue, NXOpen.BasePart.CloseAfterSave.FalseValue)
    print(">>> [NX 12.0] 双向储油耐磨导套 参数化模型创建成功！")
    print(">>> 核心表达式 D_OUTER=49.3, D_BORE=30.3, TOTAL_LENGTH=59.1 已完成几何双向挂接。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

2. 毛坯形状选圆柱棒料，直径设为 `Φ54.7mm`，长度设为 `80mm`，材质选用 45# 或 Cr12MoV。
3. 点击【卡盘夹紧】，夹持深度设为 `20.0mm`（工件有效外伸 `60.0mm`），确认无干涉。

### 2. 试切对刀与 G54 工件坐标系建立序列
在斯沃操作面板进入 `JOG`（手动）或 `HANDLE`（手轮）模式：
- **X 轴试切对刀 (基准外圆刀 T0101):**
  1. 启动主轴正转（MDI 模式键入 `M03 S800;` 并执行 `CYCLE START`）。
  2. 手轮轻碰毛坯外圆，试切一刀轻微切削痕，**Z 轴沿正向退出，X 轴保持不动**。
  3. 停主轴，用斯沃外径游标卡尺测量该试切外圆实际直径（假设为 `54.20mm`）。
  4. 按下系统面板【OFFSET SETTING】键 -> 屏幕下方选择【坐标系】软键。
  5. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `X` 栏，输入 `X54.20`，按下屏幕下方【测量】键。系统自动计算并录入机床机械绝对坐标偏差。
- **Z 轴试切对刀:**
  1. 再次启动主轴，手动平切工件端面一刀，**X 轴向外退出，Z 轴保持不动**。
  2. 光标移至 `G54` 的 `Z` 栏，直接输入 `Z0.0`，按下【测量】软键。端面原点正式确立。

### 3. 刀偏表核心参数规范：刀尖圆角半径 (R) 与 刀尖方位代号 (T)
按下【OFFSET SETTING】->【偏置】->【几何补偿】页面：
| 刀号 | 刀具类型 | 几何补偿 (X/Z) | 磨损补偿 | **刀尖圆角 (R)** | **刀尖方位代号 (T)** | 设定依据与防过切机理 |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **T01** | 前置外圆右偏车刀 (CNMG) | 试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.8`** | **`3`** | 前置刀架主偏角93°标准刀片，假想刀尖方位指向右上方，代号为 3。 |
| **T02** | 全圆弧切槽刀 (R3.0) | 槽刀左刃对刀 | 0.00 | **`3.0`** | **`8`** (圆心) 或 **`3`** (左尖) | 若以圆弧槽刀刀头圆心编程，必须录入 **8**；若以左顶点对刀则录入 **3**。 |
| **T03** | 内孔镗孔车刀 (CCMT) | 内孔试切录入 | 0.00 | **`0.4`** | **`2`** | 内孔镗刀前置假想刀尖指向工件内侧，代号必须为 2。 |

### 4. 避免过切与撞刀的关键准则
1. **刀尖圆弧半径补偿使能规范:** 执行 `G41`（左补偿）或 `G42`（右补偿）前，机床必须在空行程（G00/G01）且切入工件之前完成矢量建立；切削完毕脱离工件后，必须立即使用 `G40` 取消补偿。
2. **防过切代号检查:** 若将槽刀或成型刀的 T 代码错误设为 0 或 9，在切削圆弧过渡槽时，数控系统将发生未补偿计算，产生高达 `R*(1 - sin45°)` 的过切深度（对于 R3 刀具过切近 0.88mm，直接导致零件报废）。按照上述规范录入后，斯沃仿真过切量恒定为 0。

```python
# =========================================================================

# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Cr12MoV | OD: 53.0mm | ID: 14.0mm

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 53.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 14.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 45.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 2.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"53.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"50.0",
        f"14.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 11.25
    for i in range(1, 4):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"49.0",
            f"4.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 3.0")

    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
```
